Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an infant presenting with episodes of apnea and anemia. To understand the underlying cause, I need to know your specific age in weeks or months and whether you were born prematurely.

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential
REQUEST TEST: Arterial Blood Gas (ABG)

DIAGNOSIS READY: Premature Infant Apnea with Anemia (Note: Specific etiology such as infection, cardiac defect, or metabolic disorder requires further clarification on history and additional labs).
